definitions: To relocate oneself or something to a different place or position.
To change one's residence or place of work to a new location.
To proceed to a particular stage or action.
To be prompted or inspired to do something.
examples: We decided to move to a bigger house.
The company will move to a new office building next month.
Let's move to the next item on the agenda.
She was moved to tears by the story.
